description: Message area with scrolling and access to the latest messages.

howToUse: Use it for the area that holds the messages of a conversation and scrolls on its own.
Set `maxHeight` and a `label` ("Conversation with support"). When people scroll up, a button takes them back to the latest messages.
alternatives: Any content with its own scroll: ScrollArea.

keyboard.action: Goes back to the latest messages.

examples.label: Interactive
